h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Saharsa

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Saharsa

items.pText: Saharsa lies in the Kosi region of north Bihar, a flat stretch of plains where the river and its floods shape everyday life. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, colonies and public spaces in Saharsa and the surrounding districts. We manufacture it at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,580 km away, and send it by road.

On flood-prone ground, where you place a playground matters as much as what you put in it. Find the highest part of your site, away from drains and low corners, and plan the play area there. Send us photos taken after heavy rain if you have them, along with the site size and the age group. We will suggest equipment and a layout with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Building a playground that copes with Kosi floods

c: Raise the play area above the surrounding ground with compacted fill, and give the base a slope so water runs off. Grouted footings in concrete hold posts firmly when the soil around them is soaked. Avoid loose sand or soil as the play surface, because floodwater carries it away. Rubber flooring on a firm base is easier to clean once the water recedes.

Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic hold up far better than bare steel or untreated wood after standing in water. After any flooding, wash off silt and check bolts, springs and bearings before children play again. See our

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can playground equipment be used again after a flood?
items.a: Yes, once it has been cleaned and checked. Wash away silt, tighten bolts and inspect springs, bearings and footings. Call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 if anything looks loose or damaged.

items.q: Do you deliver to smaller towns in north Bihar?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India, and installation is done by our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

items.q: Which surface works best on low, wet ground?
items.a: A raised, compacted base with a drainage slope and rubber flooring on top. It drains faster than soil, stays in place and is easy to clean after rain or flooding.
